- [USER] User requested specific assessment tools or techniques for gathering relevant data.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Formative assessments provide ongoing feedback and can include quizzes, exit tickets, or class discussions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Summative assessments measure student achievement at a specific point in time, typically through tests, projects, or portfolios.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Performance tasks require students to apply knowledge and skills to real-world scenarios, such as projects or presentations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Observations can gather data on student behavior and engagement, using checklists or anecdotal notes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Self-assessments allow students to reflect on their learning and identify areas needing support.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Peer assessments enable students to provide feedback to each other, developing critical thinking skills.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Data analysis tools, such as spreadsheets or online platforms, help educators aggregate and analyze assessment data.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP) offers webinars and workshops on assessment data literacy.
